name: RC22 H1 (old): Loss Rebalancing (IS=0.005, VS=1.0)
result: 166a: 5/9 best, 4/9 final. S4 perfect (1.000), S8 median_bias PASS. But S2 still FAIL (spread tighter). IS reduction was the primary driver. Loss tuning reached its ceiling — architecture is the bottleneck.

name: RC22 H1 (v2): Factorized Decoder with Split Conditioning
theory: The decoder's attention trunk conflates conditional drift and stochastic factor structure. Noise enters via CLN before attention → attention compresses to rank-1. Fix: factorized output heads (base_head + load_head) with post-attention noise injection via L@eps. Split conditioning: load_head receives cond_resid (discriminative residual) via FiLM, not the 98% shared component. CRPS only, no MSE. Individual scenario authenticity.
target: Noise eff_rank > 3. S2 PASS. S3/S4/S5/S9 preserved. Total >= 7/9.
implementation: New decoder class FactorizedSpatialTransformerDecoder. base_head(h)→delta_base. load_head(FiLM(h, cond_resid))→L(25×5). eps~N(0,I_5). delta=delta_base+L@eps. frame=prev+tanh(delta). cond_ref=detached EMA. load_head small random init (std=0.01). 166a loss weights (IS=0.005, VS=1.0).
kill_condition: Stage 2 (ep20): eff_rank<3, L variance near zero, S3 regresses, delta_base under-reversion ≈ -0.22.
if_fails: Encoder 2% discriminative signal insufficient → H3 contrastive loss. Or: trunk learns degenerate h_t → need deeper architectural change.

name: RC22 H2: K Reduction (K=8, B=32)
theory: SOTA uses K=2-4. Our K=16 has centering/spread ratio 1.07. K=8 gives 1.14.

name: RC22 H3: Encoder Contrastive Loss (conditional on H1 v2)
theory: Encoder condition 98% shared. InfoNCE pushes regimes apart. Only run if H1 v2's load_head produces constant L across windows (meaning 2% discriminative signal insufficient).
target: Encoder probe accuracy improvement. L variance across windows increases.
